principles: Inputs, derived results, evidence, and presentation state are different lifecycles.
A stable entity id is not a content fingerprint and neither is a run id.
The current local-first workflow remains valid while the domain boundary is formalized.
A scenario must be reproducible from an immutable resolved input revision plus dataset and engine provenance.
Large geospatial data and RF traces are artifacts, not rows in the project aggregate.

entities.name: Project
entities.purpose: Durable planning workspace and ownership boundary.
owns: Scenario lineage and active working scenario
Inventory references or project-owned inventory revisions
Report definitions and links to generated reports
does_not_own: Every RF ray or intermediate optimizer evaluation
entities.mutability: Metadata and working pointers mutable; referenced ScenarioRevisions, Runs, and GeneratedReportArtifacts immutable.
entities.current_implementation: ProjectV2 nested in one IndexedDB workspace record.

entities.name: Inventory
entities.purpose: Reusable physical/network asset collection used to seed scenarios.
entities.current_shape: Flat cell/tower records with coordinates and RF profile; dataset cells and manual/imported cells are mixed in the current project snapshot.
future_shape: Optional import provenance and source artifact
entities.site_decision: Do not introduce Site as a required entity now. Current backend TowerStation has cell id, radio type, simulated flag, and coordinates but no authoritative stable site key. Group cells into sites only after a verified source key and grouping rule exist.
entities.mutability: Revisioned; a new import/edit creates a new inventory revision or explicit cell revision.

entities.name: InventoryCell
entities.purpose: Atomic cell/sector record consumed by RF requests.
entities.mutability: Never silently mutate a referenced scenario input; publish a new revision.

entities.name: Scenario
entities.purpose: Named planning hypothesis and lineage container inside a Project.
does_not_own: A mutable copy of every derived result
entities.mutability: Current working copy can be edited; saved revisions are immutable. Current UI's append-only Save current behavior is a compatible interim behavior.

entities.name: ScenarioRevision
entities.purpose: Exact resolved scenario inputs for a reproducible analysis.
contains: Inventory reference and cell override map
Optimization objectives, constraints, weights, search policy, budgets
entities.change_rule: An RF-affecting input change creates a new revision; UI-only changes do not.

entities.name: Dataset
entities.purpose: Versioned, validated source-data identity and provenance record.
entities.mutability: Immutable version; a new pack/version is a new Dataset.
entities.current_implementation: Manifest plus files under the local dataset root and in-memory DatasetPack.

entities.name: Run
entities.purpose: Immutable execution record for simulation, optimization, validation, batch experiment, or diagnostic work.
entities.mutability: Append-only status transition from queued/running to succeeded/failed/cancelled; result data immutable.
entities.current_implementation: Request-scoped API response or in-memory experiment job; no durable Run table.

entities.name: OptimizationSolution
entities.purpose: Public, selectable candidate from an OptimizationRun.
entities.mutability: Immutable; selecting or applying it is a new user action.
entities.application_rule: Apply as Scenario creates a new ScenarioRevision or cloned Scenario with originating_run_id and selected_solution_id; baseline inventory is unchanged.

entities.name: GeneratedArtifact
entities.purpose: Content-addressed output too large or too binary for relational/project metadata.
entities.mutability: Immutable by content hash; retention policy may delete unreferenced objects.

entities.name: ReportDefinition
entities.purpose: Mutable user selection of project/scenario/run sections and presentation options.

entities.name: GeneratedReportArtifact
entities.purpose: Immutable report output tied to exact inputs and run references.
entities.mutability: Immutable; regenerate creates a new artifact.
entities.current_implementation: Download-only Markdown or print/PDF from live state.

resolved_cell: ScenarioCellOverride when a field is explicitly set
precedence_rules.null_semantics: Use explicit clear/remove markers in the repository contract; absence means inherit, not clear.
precedence_rules.scenario_settings: ScenarioRevision settings override application defaults; server defaults are recorded in the resolved request.
precedence_rules.dataset: The exact Dataset version/hash reference on the ScenarioRevision wins over the currently active server dataset; a mismatch makes the scenario stale and blocks silent reuse.

mutability_rules.rf_or_geometry_input_change: New working revision; prior saved revision and its Runs remain immutable.
mutability_rules.dataset_change: New DatasetRef and new ScenarioRevision or explicit stale state; never silently rewrite a prior revision.
mutability_rules.inventory_change: New Inventory revision and scenario re-resolution; preserve the prior cell snapshot for old revisions.
mutability_rules.apply_optimization_solution: New scenario/revision by default; allow explicit replace only as a future, audited action.
mutability_rules.run_completion: Status and terminal metadata may be appended; result payload and fingerprints do not change.

fingerprint_rules.entity_identity: Stable ids identify Project, Scenario, ScenarioRevision, Dataset, Run, and Artifact records.
fingerprint_rules.current_scenario_fingerprint: Preserve backend atom-scenario-v1 behavior and do not change it in Concept 7A.
fingerprint_rules.future_input_fingerprint: Hash canonical resolved scenario inputs plus dataset ids/hashes, inventory revision, engine/RF contract, and optimizer contract.
fingerprint_rules.run_identity: run_id is a durable UUID; existing optimization_run_id is a compute/cache identity and is not treated as a durable database primary key.
fingerprint_rules.presentation: UI state, timestamps, request paths, and map viewport do not enter the deterministic input fingerprint unless explicitly part of the domain request.

acceptance_contract: A saved ScenarioRevision can reconstruct the exact resolved RF request.
Every durable Run records the scenario revision, dataset hashes, engine/model/RF contract, and input fingerprint.
Applying an OptimizationSolution cannot mutate the baseline Inventory or prior ScenarioRevision.
A report can be regenerated or audited from stable scenario/run/artifact references.
The browser can continue operating in local-first mode through the same domain repository interface.
